theme: An open day, with Croatia logistics closing in.
greeting: The girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete and the calendar is nearly bare, just the Valoris call at midday. The real pull today is the Croatia trip: a handful of bookings have slipped past their dates and are ready to close.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued fare shows zero checked bags, Basic Economy, both legs on Eurowings Discover. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site and buy the two duffels' allowance now, before airport-counter prices.

needsAttention.title: Lock the last night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: One night on Sept 19, airport-side, after the charter ends at ACI Komolac around noon. It has to be booked from dry land before you sail on Sept 8, and it is already past its date.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20 and 21, between the TPA landing and the Tuesday kid pickup and before the Orlando villa. Two nights still open.

needsAttention.title: Passport packet is due tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Mike is assembling the four kids' applications for the Aug 28 appointment; the DS-11s still need printing and signing and State takes a check or money order only. Worth a glance that nothing is missing.

flagged.title: Nautilus course balance is due
flagged.detail: Invoice 2170 shows a $6,475 balance for the September sailing course, and Amy's follow-up flags the final-payment window closing.

flagged.title: Home policy renewal landed
flagged.detail: Liberty Mutual sent your home policy renewal notice, worth a look before it renews on its own.

flagged.title: A US board-seat posting came through
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a non-executive director opening at ClickCore Strategies, the kind of NED seat you are tracking.

inbox.noise: The usual retail and newsletter drift: Li-Lac, Chairish, NYT Cooking, a Kickstarter pitch.

recipe.title: Chambery Trout
recipe.why: High summer is for quick, bright cooking, and a whole trout barely touched by heat lets the season's herbs and citrus do the work.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing sat on the calendar before noon.
The Valoris call was the one fixed point at midday; the rest of the afternoon is open for the trip bookings.
The girls are home with you and Mike in St. Pete, a quiet evening in.
